name: expense-api

dependencies.name: email-provider
dependencies.description: Transactional email delivery — sends status-change notifications to employees and managers on submit/approve/reject.

description: Owns expense claims, approvals, and payroll export batches. Exposes REST endpoints to create and update claims, list claims by role (employee/manager/finance), record manager decisions, and generate a CSV export of approved, not-yet-exported claims. Sends email notifications on status change via the email provider. Does not issue payroll payments or integrate with a specific payroll vendor — it only produces the downloadable export file.
